sheets.prompt: Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: the great listening hall at the cool, dark core of a station inside a sun. A vast round hall of deep indigo shadow, its dome pierced by one narrow shaft through which a single beam of white-gold sunlight falls onto a huge round lens of pale gold glass in the middle of the floor; the lens throws slow rings of light across the hall that pulse in threes; around it, rows of tall curved listening horns and taut strings stretched floor to ceiling hum and glow faintly; keepers in white and gold robes sit on low stools along the rings with their ears to small brass trumpets, one writing the pulse down as dots on a long scroll; the glyph of three dots over an upward arc is inlaid in the floor around the lens. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack stands at the edge of the light for scale. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, white-gold and saffron light, deep indigo and violet shadows, warm brass, a little cool teal, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
